BuildExecutionArtifact.title: BuildExecutionArtifact
BuildExecutionArtifact.description: Trusted exporter/loader inspection, separately compared with retained OCI.

BuildExecutionObservation.title: BuildExecutionObservation
BuildExecutionObservation.description: Internal trusted-producer protocol, never an HTTP request or a passed flag.

BuildFileInput.title: BuildFileInput
BuildFileInput.description: A relative file in the candidate or the controlled recipe bundle.

DevelopmentStorageRef.title: DevelopmentStorageRef
DevelopmentStorageRef.description: A pinned trusted registration reference; this is not a grant of authority.

MutateWorkspaceFileRequest.title: MutateWorkspaceFileRequest
MutateWorkspaceFileRequest.description: Only content identity is durable; trusted ingress stages the actual bytes.

ReconcileTaskRequest.title: ReconcileTaskRequest
ReconcileTaskRequest.description: Reinspect existing facts; this does not authorize new physical operations.

TaskBudget.title: TaskBudget
TaskBudget.description: A declared spending ceiling, not a reservation or a known actual charge.

TaskCommandResult.title: TaskCommandResult
TaskCommandResult.description: Persist exactly this result; replays do not replace it with a newer Task view.

TaskCreateRejection.title: TaskCreateRejection
TaskCreateRejection.description: A rejected declaration has no Task identity, state or business version.

WorkspaceDevelopmentEnvironmentObservati.title: WorkspaceDevelopmentEnvironmentObservation
WorkspaceDevelopmentEnvironmentObservati.description: Authenticated Runner facts; never accepted as fields on a user request.

WorkspaceDevelopmentRunnerIdentity.title: WorkspaceDevelopmentRunnerIdentity
WorkspaceDevelopmentRunnerIdentity.description: Identity attached after the Runner channel authenticates its sender.

WorkspaceFiles.title: WorkspaceFiles
WorkspaceFiles.description: Immutable receipt for the initial bytes, not current mutable view evidence.
